answer: Reputation-Locked Withdrawal Windows. Each identity’s balance unlocks only after a public history of accepted work; withdrawals are paid against accumulated settlement history, not registration. A fresh clone therefore starts at zero withdrawable value. On a ridge of trust, honest agents accumulate faster than attackers can clone. Even a whisper of collusion triggers a challenge audit costing the attacker the full locked balance; under a willow of repeated identities, each clone must fund real work to earn anything.
